reviews.text: I have been taking my animals (dogs and cats) to Dr. Sue for many years and I wouldn't trust anyone else to care for my babies.  She is so patient and knowledgeable and the staff is always curious and helpful. Thank you Dr. Sue for all of the excellent care you have provided my kids over the past 10 or so years!

I called and left a message on a Friday afternoon about bringing my 14 YO dog, Bandit in to be examined.  I also planned to switch his vet care permanently to Dr. Sue and her outstanding & caring team. Unfortunately, by the time they were able to get back to me, (only the very next day), we had already made the unfortunate, but necessary decision to let Bandit cross over the rainbow bridge as he could no longer get up, stand or walk without a great deal of assistance; blood was also noticed in his urine.  The issue(s) he was experiencing were not a way of living life for our happy boy.  Even though the clinic is closed on the weekend, I got a call back from Mary who couldn't have been more caring and compassionate when I gave her the news.  If and when we adopt another dog, we will go straight to TLC First Animal Hospital.  Thanks again Dr. Sue & Team.  Carla Marsh & Kelly Boscamp.

I’ve been seeing dr sue since I was in my early 20’s two decades ago. She has helped me take care of primarily dogs but also my former ferrets. Dr sue is straight to the point and integrates holistic medicine with western medicine. The staff couldn’t be kinder. Her only focus is on the animal and she’s made this practice into her life’s work.

I visited Dr. Sue and her Team on Friday, April 3rd. Just as my prior visits with Dr. Sue it went very well for my Lab - Riggs.  Dr. Sue and her Team are thorough, professional and never pushy.  She and her Team will always ask if there are any concerns I may have; she will offer new ideas if she has any, but never pushy.  I was recommended to Dr. Sue and her Team by another Pet Owner, and I’ve been very pleased.

I’m so happy to have discovered Dr. Sue at TLC. She’s great with my cats. They’re so calm with her. I had a 20 year old cat who was knocking at heaven’s door and Dr. Sue was able to provide a soothing passage for her across the rainbow bridge. The office staff is professional and friendly and supportive.

Dr. Sue and her entire staff are the absolute greatest you’ll ever meet. Not only are they empathetic and extremely caring, but they’re VERY well educated and I promise your loved ones are in the upmost best care with them!!

Beyond Perfect.

The vet tech Emma was an absolute angel. My cat, Kiwi, struggles with a lot of anxiety, and she knew exactly how to handle her with patience and kindness. We were taken in quickly and seen by the doctor within the first 5-10 mins, which helped us feel at ease.

The doctor was truly incredible. She helped calm Kiwi, listened carefully to every concern and question we had, and examined her thoroughly. She noticed things that other clinics missed. We left with real answers, clear next steps, and so much peace of mind.

I honestly cannot explain how wonderful this clinic is. From beginning to end, we felt cared for. Kiwi did too. I am so grateful for the compassion and professionalism we received.Thank you. Highly recommend.
Dr. Sue and her team are the best in the city !!! The most knowledgeable & empathetic dr. I wouldn't take my boy anywhere else
Great place, the vet is very straight forward and doesn't beat around the bush when it comes to what's going on with my pet.

TLC was recommended to us by a dear friend after we had a disappointing experience at another local vet. We were deeply uncertain about our dog's grim condition, but from the moment I spoke with Gail on my initial call, I felt reassured. She was incredibly kind, called me back right away, and was able to get our sick dog in that very afternoon.

The front desk team was warm and welcoming, and the vet techs were genuinely caring and compassionate. Dr. Sue was nothing short of incredible. While the future remains uncertain for our 9.5-year-old Rottweiler, she quite literally saved his life.

My husband and I have had dogs throughout our childhood and adult lives, but we have never met a veterinarian like Dr. Sue. She was truly exceptional—taking the time to explain everything clearly, making thoughtful recommendations, setting a clear plan with expectations, and following through with consistent communication. She has continued to guide us as we navigate this critical time.

Additionally, the cost was extremely reasonable, and at no point were unnecessary procedures or treatments suggested.

We have already shared our experience with family and friends and wholeheartedly recommend TLC. Without a doubt, we will continue to trust them with our pets now and in the future.
Best vet around, bar none. The whole staff is great and really care for our pets.
Staff are always friendly. Care of my pets is excellent!!

The most empathetic and caring vet that I have ever been to. The nurses were so knowledgeable and the Doctor was so caring and the  services were so affordable. I'm so grateful that my dog had his surgery there.  I have 4 other furry animals and I will never take them to another vet.
Me and my wife love Dr Sue Karma she's like family to us she's been taken care of our five Yorkies for many many many many many many years now going on 17 plus

Hope you are all okay.  Have been calling fir several days only to find your phone recording saying you will be open
July, 5, 2024. ????
Unusual as well, no call back.
I need appointment ASAP and do not want to go elsewhere.
I'LL LEAVE ANOTHER MESSAGE NOW WITH HOPE TO HEAR FROM YOU AND SEE YOU TOMORROW FRIDAY WITH GRACIE!
Dr. Sue is great and all staff are very friendly.
